description: Visitors are not authenticated, escorted, or monitored while in facilities containing CUI. This signal indicates that unauthorized access by visitors may go undetected.
applicability: Applicable to all visitor management procedures. Includes visitor sign-in, badge issuance, escort requirements, and visitor monitoring in secure areas.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through visitor management procedure review, escort policy verification, and visitor log assessment.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
